fact: Car 27 allegedly left the track and gained an advantage in Turn 2
offence: Alleged breach of Article B1.8.6 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence. The Stewards reviewed video evidence. Cars 41, 27 and 43 were alongside each other going into turn 1 after the race start. Car 27 left the track and rejoined behind Car 41 and ahead of Car 43. The Stewards considered the positioning of the cars before entering turn 1 (i.e. the braking point) and the circumstances under which the cars left the track. They also took into account that the incident happened in lap 1, turn 1. The Stewards determine that no lasting advantage has been gained by Car 27 and take no further action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 27 Alleged Leaving The Track And Gaining An Advantage
to: The Team Manager, Audi Revolut F1 Team
